stem: Which statement best describes how a pediatric dentist should approach the use of pharmacologic behavior modification?

options.text: Use it when the harm from leaving oral disease untreated would be greater than the benefit the non-pharmacologic approaches can offer.
Use it as the initial step for every child, before any other behavior guidance option is tried.
Choose it on the basis of the child's temperament alone.
Choose the agent without regard to the patient's medical condition when the clinician is experienced.
Regard it as a basic behavior guidance technique, in the same category as routine communicative approaches.
